reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin plugin providing five Chaldea-inspired themes with generated SVG backgrounds, decorative styling, theme selection in settings, and localStorage persistence; the README states it only changes presentation and does not access session, model-request, or workspace data.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供五套迦勒底风格主题、生成式 SVG 背景和可持久化的皮肤选择。
summaries.en: Provides five Chaldea-inspired themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with generated SVG backgrounds and persistent skin selection.

capabilities: Overrides UI color tokens and adds decorative background layers
Stores the selected theme in browser localStorage
